notes.title: PATCHNOTES 26-APR-2024
notes.content:
- New Bible Log
- German translation for every text and widget
- Surrounding environment for Capernaum added
- lots of Bugs fixed
- Performance improvements
- Settings menu updated

notes.title: PATCHNOTES 13-APR-2024
notes.content:
Besides some bugs, we've worked on important features like settings, localisation and more!! 
There are some bugs and missing translation we are aware of, but we need you to help us find them all.
Also feel free to share your thoughts and improvement proposals. 

Patch Highlights:
- Settings-Menu including Graphics, Audio, Language Please test if everything works & share your thoughts about the wording currently implemented
- First batch of localized texts - Added German: Help us identify which texts are still in english! If you speak german: let us know about wording-improvements and general feedback
- Surrounding of Capernaum: We've started to add environment, which is an ongoing process

notes.title: PATCHNOTES 21-MAR-2024
notes.content:
Some last changes before going live on our official steam page! Happy Spring!

Bugfixes including:
UI issues in existing widgets, adjustments for better guidance and flow

Patch Highlights:
New tutorial widget at the start of the game to help introduce non-gamers to the controls!
New Bible Log Entry after studying the scroll!
Sequences reworked & new dialogue choice added with more consequences!

notes.title: PATCHNOTES 19-FEB-2024
notes.content:
We've heard YOUR feedback and made quite some changes!
Besides some bugs, we've worked on different parts of the game, like visuals, gameplay, and new content.


Bugfixes including:
Timing of off-sync voicelines, UI problems in cutscenes, camera fixes.

Challenges overcome:
Implementation of new idles making the NPCs more alive, solutions for gameplay and pacing, bugs related to new implementations

Patch Highlights:
Reworked Intro-Cutscene! Gameplay changes and story flow at Noah's house, Ben's house, and in the Synagogue! New Content and inspect objects!

notes.title: PATCHNOTES 24-JAN-2024
notes.content:
The Early-Access Community Launch of our Prologue goes into the next round!
Some critical Bugs were erased, while features got added and improved, besides some things we implemented for testing.

Bugfixes including:
TakeObject Fixes (especially the vases) to prevent breaking the game, off-sync facial animations, camera fixes and more.

Challenges overcome:
Collision issues and weird input behaviour.

Patch Highlights:
Bible Log implemented into flow and accessible through story! Reworked Cutscenes, Gameplay Animation Improvements!

notes.title: PATCHNOTES 11-JAN-2024
notes.content:
Lots in store in this first patch of 2024!
Bugs, Improvements, completion of WIP Features, and more after this first playtest-iteration lead by the ONEof500 Discord community & longtime friends/partners/supporters.

Bugfixes including: 
Animation behaviour in sequences, off-sync voicelines, asset glitches, traps for players to get stuck and more. 

Challenges overcome: 
Nasty crashes resulting from bigger changes and bugfixes. Software bugs. 

Patch Highlights:
Notification Improvements, Reworked Cutscenes, Gameplay Improvements, Updated flow
